verdict.rationale: Metorial's catalog/portal features support discovering and connecting to integrations (docs-9, docs-29, docs-33) and tool filters reference specific tool names (docs-16), implying some visibility into a provider's tools, but there is no direct evidence of a UI/API that lets a developer inspect input schemas, transport type, or hosting attributes for a listed server prior to connecting. Missing for 10: explicit schema/tool inspection view, transport type disclosure (stdio/SSE/HTTP), hosting attribute details (self-hosted vs Metorial-hosted) surfaced pre-connection, and independent confirmation of this discovery workflow.
